disassembly.title: Disassembly
disassembly.emptyHint: Launch a sample and stop at main to see instructions around RIP.

stack.title: Stack memory
stack.hint: RSP-centred window · high address on top
stack.emptyBody: Launch a teaching sample from the toolbar. Rows are rendered only from a real GDB snapshot; unreadable bytes stay --, never zero.
stack.rspOutside: RSP {{address}} is outside the current stack window
stack.rbpOutside: RBP {{address}} is outside the current stack window
stack.unreadableRanges: {{count}} unreadable range(s) · marked unknown, not zero

registers.title: Registers
registers.footer: GDB/MI3 live values · click RSP/RBP to center stack

inspector.hint: Select any stack byte; values come from the current GDB snapshot.
inspector.noSnapshot: No snapshot yet. Launch a session and stop at main.
inspector.clickHint: Click a byte cell in Stack Memory to inspect address, byte, qword and ASCII.
inspector.pointerBody: Pointer target reads are capped at 64 bytes by the backend; this is not an unbounded dereference.
inspector.byteUnknownHint: GDB could not read this byte; shown as unknown, not zero.
inspector.selectionOnly: Selection only; no breakpoint is created.
inspector.outsideWindow: Selected address is outside the current stack window.

diff.emptyHint: Step the real process and the byte-level diff will appear here.
diff.noRegisterChanged: no register changed between these snapshots
diff.noByteChanged: no byte in the overlapping stack window changed

explanation.emptyHint: Explanations are generated only from a real before/after snapshot. No instruction simulator or guessed semantics are used.
explanation.noPrevious: No previous snapshot; execution history starts here.
explanation.nextInstruction: next instruction (current RIP, not executed yet)
explanation.rbpNote: RBP is shown only as a register. PWNviz does not assume it is a fixed frame base, and does not label the space between RSP and RBP as local variables.
explanation.unreadableNote: {{count}} unreadable range(s); unknown bytes are not treated as zero.

log.empty: No session events yet. Create a session to see debugger events here.

environment.verifyTitle: Load pwndbg into a throwaway GDB process to prove it works
environment.runBackend: run from the repo root: bash scripts/dev_backend.sh
environment.probingBody: Running real host probes: gdb --version, embedded Python, MI3 support, pwndbg detection and sample discovery...
environment.noWarnings: No warnings: GDB, MI3 and the embedded Python interpreter are all usable.

variables.title: Variables
variables.noSnapshotHint: Stop a real process to inspect DWARF-backed locals and arguments.
variables.noDwarfBody: GDB did not provide debug-info-backed variables for this frame. PWNviz does not infer variable storage from raw QWORDs; the Stack Memory Canvas and Registers remain the authoritative raw views.
variables.emptyHint: GDB returned an empty variable list.
variables.deferredBody: Fast snapshots do not build the variable tree. Press Refresh variables to re-read the current frame from GDB.
variables.cachedBody: These values come from an earlier snapshot and were not re-measured. Press Refresh variables to read current values.
variables.addressTitle: Inspect this variable's address in the stack window
variables.warnings: Variables come from GDB variable objects (source=dwarf, confidence=debug-info); pointer targets are bounded memory reads.
